Sign Up Now

Any funded startup is eligible to apply, whether you're seed-funded, backed by well-known angel investors, Shark Tank-funded, or have raised Series A to Series C rounds. The program is currently open to new merchants who haven't actively used the Razorpay ecosystem in the past 3 months or more.
Simply fill out the application form on the Razorpay Startup Perks page or write to us at startups@razorpay.com. Our team will review your application and get back to you within 1–2 business days.
Razorpay Startup Perks offer up to ₹30 lakhs in benefits, with more perks available as you integrate additional products. These benefits cover tools like Payment Gateway, Current Account, Payroll, Magic Checkout, and more. Additionally, you have the opportunity to raise up to ₹1 million in funding.
Razorpay Startup Perks is designed to support startups at every stage of their journey—from incorporation to growth and scale. Whether you're seed-funded, backed by angel investors, Shark Tank-funded, or have raised Series A to Series C, the program is built to grow with you.
Not necessarily. If your startup meets the funding criteria—whether seed, angel, Shark Tank, or Series A to C—you are eligible to apply, even if you're not yet formally incorporated.
The only difference is the value of benefits offered. Regardless of your stage, the program supports you through the crucial months of testing and initial scaling.
No, the program is currently available only to new merchants. However, if you face any support issues, please reach out to us, and we will connect you with the right team.

A comprehensive payments suite in India designed to help businesses seamlessly accept, process, and disburse payments. It gives you access to all payment modes including credit card, debit card, netbanking, UPI and popular wallets including JioMoney, Mobikwik, Airtel Money, FreeCharge, Ola Money and PayZapp.

RazorpayX supercharges your business banking experience, bringing effectiveness, efficiency, and excellence to all financial processes. With RazorpayX, businesses can get access to fully-functional current accounts, supercharge their payouts and automate payroll compliance.


Manage your marketplace, automate bank transfers, collect recurring payments, share invoices with customers and avail working capital loans - all from a single platform. Fast forward your business with Razorpay.

Disclaimer: The RazorpayX powered Current Account and VISA corporate credit card are provided by RBI licensed banks. Your RazorpayX powered current account is provided by our partner banks i.e, ICICI, RBL, Yes bank, in accordance with RBI regulations. RazorpayX itself is not a bank and doesn't hold or claim to hold a banking license.
